summary.result: In conclusion, the polymer mortar protection block is excellent and useful as industrial products for erosion control works.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to develop a polymer mortar protection block with high strength and durability using unsaturated polyester resin to complement defects of conventional cement mortar protection block.
summary.method: Low absorptivity, high impact strength, and great bending strength of the polymer mortar protection block was compared with those of the conventional cement protection block.
